address: Oude Turfmarkt 139 / Binnengasthuisstraat 46, Amsterdam: Binnengasthuis complex (UvA), brick civic front on the canal and white balconied housing block in the courtyard street
notes: Oude Turfmarkt 139 / Binnengasthuisstraat 46 (BAG), the Binnengasthuis complex of the Universiteit van Amsterdam (3DBAG built 1643; a 17th-century hospital quadrangle with later 20th-century housing). 3DBAG holds the whole complex as one pand: 746 wall surfaces. Only two walls have usable panoramas (the other long walls have 0 candidates within 35 m).

Group 0 (SW run on the canal, surfaces from panels 54/195/57/64/69/226; w05-235, 2017-07-06): five-storey brown brick civic front with a pale cornice and a UNIVERSITEIT VAN AMSTERDAM name band under it, nine axes of tall white-framed sashes. Modelled as brick-bay-grid, 5 storeys, 8-9 bays, cornice; the name band lettering, the banded arched cellar windows and the entrance are not modelled (the entrance and lettering sit on a neighbouring wall).

Group 1 (E wall, panel 104; w03-91, 2016-06-09): white rendered block with orange-framed wide windows, glass-block stair, a curved balcony stack and a glass entrance canopy. Modelled as 3 storeys of low windows in pale cream brick (the house has one wall material, brick; render would need a per-group wallMaterial). Not modelled: curved balconies, glass-block stair, canopy and the fourth floor (the eaves allow three storeys here).
All other walls (courtyard, N, S, NE) are blank: no photograph.
